brand_notes.fabric: brands.json's brand-level fabric string is 'X-Pac (visible X ripstop grid) / Cordura (matte woven), customer-selectable panel colors'. Confirmed across all five products: Dha Frame Bag ('durable water-resistant Cordura and waterproof X-Pac fabrics'), Top Tube Bag ('Cordura or X-Pac'), Bagel Bar Bag ('water-resistant Olive Cordura' exterior, 'VX21 Federal Yellow' liner), Dropper Saddlebag ('1000D Cordura and waterproof X-Pac' edges), Sidekick ('X-Pac VX21' exterior and liner). Photos back this up: the Dha's red panel and the Top Tube Bag's grey top panel both show a faint diagonal diamond grid consistent with X-Pac's laid-in X-ply, while the black panels on the same two bags are flat matte Cordura with no grid - exactly the two-fabric mixed construction the brand string describes. 'Customer-selectable panel colors' is also correct - every product is sold as 'Custom ___' with a colour/fabric picker. No discrepancy found for this brand.
brand_notes.method: straightcutdesign.com redirects www<->non-www and is Shopify; plain curl (no -A needed, though used anyway) returned full server-rendered HTML with all copy and image URLs for every product page - no client-side tab issue. No local photos in assets/products/straight-cut-design/ (folder doesn't exist) - all evidence here is remote, pulled via curl against the live product pages.

products.name: Custom Dha Frame Bag
products.dims_note: Single fixed figure on the maker's page, matches brands.json exactly - no range, no swap needed. (A separate dimension diagram found on-site, 'Aon_Frame_Bag_Dimensions', gives 310mm/2L figures for a different, smaller SKU - not used here, this is specifically the Dha's own published spec.)

geometry.notes: Full frame-triangle bag, tall squared nose at the head tube tapering in a straight line down to a narrow point at the seat tube/BB junction. Flat back rides against both tubes. Small grommet visible near the low point of the wedge, consistent with the maker's stated 'drainage hole on lower edge'.

closure.hardware: YKK water-repellent zip with a custom puller reinforced with a strip of repurposed inner-tube rubber (visible as the blue rubbery tab near the zip start)

straps.notes: lace-up loop tabs along the top edge - maker copy: 'lace-up system compatible with additional top tube bags'
two cam-buckle compression straps at the low front corner, reinforced with repurposed inner-tube rubber per maker copy

pockets.notes: maker copy: non-drive-side slim access pocket for phone/essentials - the reviewed photo shows only the drive side, so this pocket itself is not directly visible

details.fabric: Cordura (drive-side lower/yellow panel, matte, no visible grid) / X-Pac (red upper panel, faint diagonal grid visible) - matches brand string. See brand_notes.fabric
details.hydrationPort: cable/hydration port along the top edge, per maker copy

mount.notes: Frame-mount only. Maker copy mentions a 'leg clearance design' - the lower-front corner in the photo reads slightly chamfered, consistent with pedalling clearance, though the effect is subtle at this angle.

products.name: Custom Top Tube Bag (Large)
products.dims_note: This is a TAPER, not a roll/range - the bag is a fixed-height wedge that is 80mm tall at the nose and 50mm at the tail, not an adjustable bag with a min/max height. Per the taper rule, the LARGER value (80mm=8cm) goes in dims_cm/hgt and the taper itself is recorded in geometry.taper (nose 1.0, tail 0.625) - matches brands.json's existing hgt:8 unchanged. Width (100mm=10cm) is constant along the bag's length per the page, not tapered.

geometry.notes: Tall squared nose (head-tube end) tapering to a lower rear, clearly visible in the photo. Closed-cell foam at the side and frame contact points per maker copy - semi-rigid, holds its wedge shape, should not be deformed like a floppy pouch.

closure.hardware: YKK Aquaguard water-repellent zip, one-handed operation per maker copy

straps.notes: maker copy: 'supplied with compression velcro straps'; exact count not stated, 2 assumed as typical for this bag size
alternative steerer-mount option (vertical webbing rail) per maker copy - not shown in this photo, offered instead of/alongside the top-tube straps

details.fabric: Cordura (black side/base panels, matte) / X-Pac (grey top panel, faint diagonal grid visible) - matches brand string. See brand_notes.fabric

products.name: Custom Dropper Seatpost Saddlebag
products.dims_raw: Length: 330mm; Height: 120mm; Capacity: 4.5L; Weight: 265g excl. Wolftooth Valais collar
products.dims_note: Maker publishes length and height only - no width figure anywhere on the page. len (33) and hgt (12) are maker-confirmed and carried through unchanged. wid (15, inherited from brands.json) is NOT maker-published; it is an inherited estimate, not something I verified. Volume check (33x15x12=5.94L vs stated 4.5L, ratio 1.32) is within the normal soft-bag 1.0-2.5x range so it isn't obviously wrong, but it remains unconfirmed - flagging rather than silently trusting it.

geometry.notes: Only distant, full-bike lifestyle photos were available for this product (no close studio shot) - visible as a compact, low-profile wedge tucked tight and high under the saddle on a full-suspension dropper-post bike, consistent with the maker's minimum-clearance requirement below. Exact panel/taper detail isn't resolvable at this photo distance, so geometry confidence here is medium, not high.

closure.hardware: cam buckle compression strap; maker copy specifies a minimum of three rolls for a secure seal

details.seams: sewn, bar-tacked at all attachment points
details.fabric: 1000D Cordura and waterproof X-Pac edges / customer-selected side panels and liner - matches brand string. See brand_notes.fabric
details.internalShim: HDPE plastic shim maintains a fixed position below the saddle, per maker copy

mount.notes: 3-point attachment (saddle-rail strap + seatpost strap, both cam-buckle) plus an HDPE shim that holds it in a fixed position - designed specifically to clear a dropper post's full travel. Maker states a MINIMUM 150mm tyre-to-seatpost clearance requirement and explicit incompatibility with electronic dropper posts (RockShox Reverb AXS, Magura Vyron eLECT) - flag as a fitment constraint, not a universal seatpack. Wolftooth Valais collar compatible as an accessory, not modelled. Max recommended load 5kg.
